options_for_orchestrator: 1. Permit network for the V0 index step only (run index without --network none, serve still --network none), recorded in the manifest and release report as an explicit deviation.

2. Prefetch the pinned tree-sitter-language-pack 1.6.0 grammars once with network on the host into a cache directory that is recorded by digest and mounted into the offline V0 index container at HOME=/tmp/...; V0 index and serve remain --network none, the cache is a declared input.
3. Record V0 as not_run (docker_unavailable/image_absent do not apply; a new reason would be needed) and accept that the release goal 'V0 included' is unmet.

first_attempt.stop_rule: (a) V0 offline index fails on a grammar fetch -> stop and escalate; never substitute another build
first_attempt.note: offline V0 index without a grammar cache exited 0 with files_indexed=0 (see a_v0.index_offline); escalated and resolved by the orchestrator (option A)

orchestrator_decision: option A: prefetch the pinned grammar set once with network in a separate recorded step; V0 index and serve run --network none --pull never with the cache mounted read-only
